reviewItem.question: For "New CRD `managedresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.crossplane.io` (ManagedResourceDefinition, v1alpha1)", which environments are exposed? Confirm or correct the exposure condition.

exposure.needed: whether the environment manages CRDs separately from the Crossplane release or relies on bundled CRD installation

proposed.statement: A new CRD for ManagedResourceDefinition (managedresourcedefinitions.apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1alpha1) was added and must be installed before upgrading if CRDs are managed separately from the release.
